# Data profiling (auto-generated by `python -m scripts.profile_data`)

Queries: `sql/profiling.sql`. These are the checks that uncovered the traps documented in
`src/catalog.yaml` and targeted by the benchmark questions.

## Table sizes and the ID hierarchy (patients > admissions > ICU stays)

```sql
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients)                         AS patients,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admissions)                       AS admissions,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM icustays)                         AS icu_stays,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) FROM icustays)       AS patients_with_icu_stay,
    (SELECT MAX(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM admissions GROUP BY subject_id)) AS max_admissions_one_patient
```

|   patients |   admissions |   icu_stays |   patients_with_icu_stay |   max_admissions_one_patient |
|-----------:|-------------:|------------:|-------------------------:|-----------------------------:|
|        100 |          275 |         140 |                      100 |                           20 |

## Trap - ICD codes that exist in BOTH version 9 and version 10 (join on code AND version)

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS codes_in_both_versions
FROM (
    SELECT icd_code FROM d_icd_diagnoses
    GROUP BY icd_code
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT icd_version) > 1
)
```

|   codes_in_both_versions |
|-------------------------:|
|                      493 |

## Trap - lab test names that map to more than one itemid

```sql
SELECT d.label, d.itemid, d.fluid, d.category, COUNT(l.itemid) AS results
FROM d_labitems d
LEFT JOIN labevents l ON l.itemid = d.itemid
WHERE d.label IN ('Glucose', 'Creatinine', 'Potassium', 'Hemoglobin')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY d.label, results DESC
```

| Creatinine |    50912 | Blood            | Chemistry  |      3003 |

| Glucose    |    51478 | Urine            | Hematology |       339 |
| Glucose    |    50809 | Blood            | Blood Gas  |       262 |
| Glucose    |    52569 | Blood            | Chemistry  |         0 |
| Glucose    |    51981 | Urine            | Chemistry  |         0 |
| Hemoglobin |    51222 | Blood            | Hematology |      2787 |
| Hemoglobin |    50811 | Blood            | Blood Gas  |       143 |
| Hemoglobin |    51640 | Blood            | Chemistry  |         0 |
| Potassium  |    50971 | Blood            | Chemistry  |      3022 |
| Potassium  |    50833 | Other Body Fluid | Blood Gas  |         0 |

## Trap - look-alike lab names ('%lactate%' also matches lactate dehydrogenase)

```sql
SELECT d.label, d.itemid, d.fluid, COUNT(*) AS results, MAX(l.valuenum) AS max_value
FROM labevents l
JOIN d_labitems d ON l.itemid = d.itemid
WHERE d.label ILIKE '%lactate%'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY results DESC
```

| label                          |   itemid | fluid   |   results |   max_value |
|:-------------------------------|---------:|:--------|----------:|------------:|
| Lactate                        |    50813 | Blood   |       758 |        13.2 |
| Lactate Dehydrogenase (LD)     |    50954 | Blood   |       663 |     16200   |
| Lactate Dehydrogenase, Pleural |    51054 | Pleural |         9 |      2301   |
| Lactate Dehydrogenase, Ascites |    50843 | Ascites |         7 |       199   |

## Trap - look-alike ICU items ('%heart rate%' also matches alarm settings)

```sql
SELECT d.itemid, d.label, d.category, COUNT(*) AS measurements, ROUND(AVG(c.valuenum), 1) AS avg_value
FROM chartevents c
JOIN d_items d ON c.itemid = d.itemid
WHERE d.label ILIKE '%heart rate%'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY measurements DESC
```

|   itemid | label                   | category            |   measurements |   avg_value |
|---------:|:------------------------|:--------------------|---------------:|------------:|
|   220045 | Heart Rate              | Routine Vital Signs |          13913 |        91.1 |
|   220046 | Heart rate Alarm - High | Alarms              |           1217 |       125.5 |
|   220047 | Heart Rate Alarm - Low  | Alarms              |           1208 |        57.8 |

## Trap - '%invasive ventilation%' also matches Non-invasive ventilation

```sql
SELECT d.itemid, d.label, COUNT(DISTINCT p.stay_id) AS icu_stays
FROM procedureevents p
JOIN d_items d ON p.itemid = d.itemid
WHERE d.label ILIKE '%invasive ventilation%'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY icu_stays DESC
```

|   itemid | label                    |   icu_stays |
|---------:|:-------------------------|------------:|
|   225792 | Invasive Ventilation     |          60 |
|   225794 | Non-invasive Ventilation |           8 |

## Trap - DRG codes come in two systems (admissions counted twice without a filter)

```sql
SELECT drg_type,
       COUNT(*)                AS rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT hadm_id) AS admissions
FROM drgcodes
GROUP BY drg_type
```

| drg_type   |   rows |   admissions |
|:-----------|-------:|-------------:|
| HCFA       |    233 |          233 |
| APR        |    221 |          221 |

## Trap - microbiology has one row per organism x antibiotic; 'CANCELLED' is not an organism

```sql
SELECT org_name,
       COUNT(*)                          AS rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT micro_specimen_id) AS specimens
FROM microbiologyevents
WHERE org_name IN ('ESCHERICHIA COLI', 'CANCELLED')
GROUP BY org_name
```

| org_name         |   rows |   specimens |
|:-----------------|-------:|------------:|
| ESCHERICHIA COLI |    296 |          26 |
| CANCELLED        |     17 |          17 |

## Trap - outpatient measurements are stored as text with units in the name

```sql
SELECT result_name, COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(result_value) AS example_value
FROM omr
GROUP BY result_name
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 6
```

| result_name            |   rows | example_value   |
|:-----------------------|-------:|:----------------|
| Weight (Lbs)           |    941 | 100             |
| Blood Pressure         |    866 | 100/58          |
| BMI (kg/m2)            |    773 | 14.6            |
| Height (Inches)        |    378 | 5               |
| Blood Pressure Sitting |      2 | 100/78          |
| Blood Pressure Lying   |      2 | 109/47          |

## Trap - dates are shifted into the future for privacy

```sql
SELECT MIN(admittime) AS first_admission, MAX(dischtime) AS last_discharge
FROM admissions
```

| first_admission            | last_discharge             |
|:---------------------------|:---------------------------|
| 2110-04-11T15:08:00.000000 | 2201-12-17T13:45:00.000000 |

## Trap - anchor_age is age in the anchor year, not at each admission

```sql
SELECT p.subject_id, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, a.admittime,
       p.anchor_age + year(a.admittime) - p.anchor_year AS age_at_admission
FROM admissions a
JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
WHERE year(a.admittime) <> p.anchor_year
ORDER BY p.subject_id, a.admittime
LIMIT 5
```

|   subject_id |   anchor_age |   anchor_year | admittime           |   age_at_admission |
|-------------:|-------------:|--------------:|:--------------------|-------------------:|
|     10002428 |           80 |          2155 | 2156-04-12 14:16:00 |                 81 |
|     10002428 |           80 |          2155 | 2156-04-30 20:35:00 |                 81 |
|     10002428 |           80 |          2155 | 2156-05-11 14:49:00 |                 81 |
|     10002428 |           80 |          2155 | 2157-07-16 04:09:00 |                 82 |
|     10002428 |           80 |          2155 | 2160-04-14 12:30:00 |                 85 |
